description: Variables (exact type expression, required/optional, default, sensitive/nullable/ephemeral, validation count), outputs and module calls of a module in THIS working directory: the root, a local module directory, or an installed module by address (module.network, resolved through .terraform/modules/modules.json, so downloaded registry/git modules work). Module calls are checked against what is installed. For public registry modules you have not installed, use the official terraform MCP server.

description_chars.description: Truncate each description to this many characters; 0 = no limit (default 160)

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (need not be initialized for the root or a local path). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

module.description: Module to describe: omitted = the root; a module address like 'module.network' or 'module.a.module.b' (resolved through .terraform/modules/modules.json, so downloaded registry/git modules work); or a directory path relative to dir

name: tf_module_interface
